description: Ask the user for a decision or feedback. Put several independent questions in one call; if one answer would change another question, ask separately. Per question: single-select (up to 4 choices; put your recommended option first, the UI marks it '(Recommended)' and appends an 'Other' free-text row), multi-select (multi_select=true), or open-ended (omit choices). Options go ONLY in `choices`, never in the question text, where the user cannot click them. Result: {responses: [...], outcome}. Responses come back in question order with the question text echoed; each has status answered, skipped or unanswered (user_response is null unless answered). outcome is submitted, cancelled, timed_out or undelivered, with a notice saying why when the wait ended without a submit. Prefer deciding low-stakes questions yourself. Not for dangerous-command confirmation (the terminal tool handles that).
name: clarify

questions.description: 1-5 questions; a single question is a one-entry array.
